    Lineage & disposition

    Every card preserves its declared origin, but this is only a new candidate.

    “OPEN IN PANEL LOOM” exports an importable panel-loom/v1 JSON file. Import it into the separate Panel Loom app using its JSON import control.

    What the recombinator does—and deliberately does not do

    It runs reproducible, rule-based composition. A selected person's desire and an unresolved thread's pressure provide the narrative conflict. Five structural beats are suggested. No image generation, model inference, canonical rewrite, publication, external synchronization, or undocumented origin verification occurs. Human editorial judgment still determines coherence and release.
